description: PAID: run Python or JavaScript code (python3, node) in an isolated, network-less sandbox; returns stdout, stderr and exit code. Price scales with limits. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

files.description: Optional extra files, as POST /execute takes them.

limits.description: Optional limits (timeoutMs, memoryMb, ...); they set the price.
